trust_decision.summary: uFldNodeComms takes the sending vehicle's identity from the self-declared src_node field in the NODE_MESSAGE/MEDIATED_MESSAGE payload and uses it for routing, range/group criteria and the relayed message, without checking it against the MOOS message's actual origin (community/source) as the broker apps do.

landing_point.why: The summary names uFldNodeComms and node-message source spoofing; handleMailNodeMessage is where the src_node is read and keyed (line 352) and msg_src is already passed in but only used to fill src_app (lines 348-349).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: uFldMessageHandler is a separate vehicle-side app that only receives what uFldNodeComms already relayed, and ACK_MESSAGE is a separate 2022 feature using a different message class, so a solver can argue both are outside 'uFldNodeComms node message' spoofing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: When src_app is missing, the MOOS source is legitimately used to fill it in, and shoreside apps or locally bridged behaviours (IvPBehavior posts NODE_MESSAGE_LOCAL) must still be relayed. A fix that rejects every message whose community differs from src_node, or that requires the source app, breaks shoreside-originated and locally posted messages.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ACK_MESSAGE: src= is taken from the payload and used as the sender for range/stale checks and relay, with no origin check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Acks are a separate 2022 feature with their own AckMessage class and carry no variable payload, so spoofing them looks low-impact.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different handler; parser in ivp/src/lib_mbutil/AckMessage.cpp:92-105

O8_uncovered_routes.route: NODE_REPORT / NODE_REPORT_LOCAL: vehicle name comes from the report's NAME field, so a sender can plant a ledger position/group for another vname that later gates message range/group checks
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are node reports, not node messages, and are handled in shared ContactLedger code (ivp/src/lib_geodaid/ContactLedger.cpp:190-227) used by many apps.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; producer in another package (lib_geodaid)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: uFldMessageHandler on the vehicle accepts NODE_MESSAGE and re-posts var_name with src_node as source aux, with no origin check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a different app on the vehicle side and assumes uFldNodeComms already validated the message.
